title: Vaultdraw config.toml
description: Generated from the app's key table by `yarn docs:config`; do not edit. Put `#:schema ./config.schema.json` at the top of config.toml (with this file next to it) for completion in Taplo-based editors.

appearance.description: Theme, light or dark mode, and canvas colours.

theme.description: Colour theme: a built-in name or a theme in `themes/`.

mode.description: Light, dark, or follow the system.

sync_canvas.description: The canvas background, pencil and palette colours follow the theme.

canvas_background.description: Canvas background for new drawings when `sync_canvas` is off.

accent_color.description: Replaces the theme's primary colour, nudged for contrast; empty uses the theme's own.

snippets.description: CSS snippets to apply, by file name in `snippets/` without `.css`, in this order. See [CSS snippets](#css-snippets).

font_family.description: Font of new text: 1 Virgil, 2 Helvetica, 3 Cascadia, 5 Excalifont, 6 Nunito, 7 Lilita One, 8 Comic Shanns, 9 Liberation Sans, 10 Assistant.

paper.description: Paper for new drawings; each drawing can change it from the canvas menu. See [Notebook backgrounds](#notebook-backgrounds).

major_every.description: Grid and graph: a stronger line every N lines.

margin_line.description: Ruled lines: draw the margin line.

page.description: Page mode for new drawings: simulated pages instead of the infinite canvas. See [Page mode](#page-mode).

layout.description: Separate sheets with a gap, or one long continuous page.

paper_theme.description: Page colours: normal, old school, or match the current theme.

pdf_import.description: Importing PDF pages as images. See [PDF import](#pdf-import).

max_side.description: Longest side of each page image in pixels.

lock_pages.description: Lock imported pages so annotating does not drag them.

warn_pages.description: Ask before importing more pages than this.

pixel_budget_mp.description: Decoded-pixel budget per import; large PDFs get a lower resolution.

autosave_delay_ms.description: Idle time in milliseconds before an edit is written to disk.

interface.description: The app window around the canvas.

show_tag_chips.description: Show a drawing's tags as chips in the file navigator.

thumbnails.description: Show drawing thumbnails (home, search, palette, gallery).

thumbnail_max_elements.description: Biggest drawing (in elements) that gets a thumbnail.

thumbnail_cache_mb.description: Size cap of a vault's thumbnail cache on disk, in megabytes; the oldest thumbnails go first. Applies at the next thumbnail saved.

defer_home_pane.description: When a vault opens, paint the file tree first and the home pane one frame later, in the same place; `false` draws both together.

activity_bar_order.description: Activity bar entry order: `library`, `history`, `graph`, `gallery`, `search`, `tags`, `templates`, `hotkeys`, `settings`; unlisted entries follow in their default order.

library.description: Named libraries: each `.excalidrawlib` file is a section in the library panel. See [Library](#library).

folders.description: Extra folders of `.excalidrawlib` files, each file a library (absolute paths, or starting with `~/`). The panel looks at them again when the window gains focus.

default.description: Name of the library that takes new items when you add without choosing a section; `""` (or a name that does not exist) means Personal.

sort.description: Sort order; folders always come first, names compare by number.

confirm_delete.description: Ask before moving a drawing to the Trash.

new_drawing_folder.description: Folder for new drawings, relative to the vault root; empty puts them next to the open drawing.

templates_folder.description: Vault folder holding your templates. See [Templates](#templates).

list_start.description: When every vault folder is listed for recent drawings, the file switcher, link suggestions and the move dialog: `open`, `idle` or `use` (the first of those). The file tree loads at open either way. See [Startup](#startup).

speculative_open.description: Read and parse a drawing when you press on it in the file tree, a tab or the switcher, before the click lands, so it opens sooner. Holds one drawing for a moment; costs nothing when off or unused. See [Speed trade-offs](#speed-trade-offs).

open_modifier.description: Modifier that opens a link on click.

update_on_rename.description: Rewrite links when a drawing is renamed or moved; `"ask"` asks each time.

hint_chars.description: Letters used by link hint mode.

style_links.description: Draw `[[links]]` in text with the link colour and an underline.

color.description: Link colour; `accent` uses the theme accent.

hover_preview.description: When the hover preview card shows.

start.description: When the link index starts: `open` (vault open), `idle` (once the app is idle) or `use` (first links action). Starting links also starts search. See [Startup](#startup).

pane_sort.description: Order of the Tags pane: by name or by use count.

pens.description: Saved pens of the freedraw tool (Alt+1 to Alt+9 by default).

presets.description: The saved pens, in order. `width` 0.5 thin, 1 medium, 2 bold, about 10 highlighter; `smoothing` 0 (raw) to 1; `highlighter` draws behind everything.

decay_ms.description: Time until the trail fades, in milliseconds.

tools.description: Default style per drawing tool, one `[tools.<tool>]` table each. See [Tool defaults](#tool-defaults).

rectangle.description: Default style of the rectangle tool. Only the keys you set apply; the others keep the editor's current style.

diamond.description: Default style of the diamond tool. Only the keys you set apply; the others keep the editor's current style.

ellipse.description: Default style of the ellipse tool. Only the keys you set apply; the others keep the editor's current style.

arrow.description: Default style of the arrow tool. Only the keys you set apply; the others keep the editor's current style.

line.description: Default style of the line tool. Only the keys you set apply; the others keep the editor's current style.

text.description: Default style of the text tool. Only the keys you set apply; the others keep the editor's current style.

enabled.description: Open several drawings at once; `false` is one drawing at a time.

show_strip.description: Show the tab strip; `never` switches tabs with the keyboard only.

open_from_navigator.description: Opening from the file tree replaces the open drawing (`current`) or opens a new tab.

focus_new.description: Switch to a drawing opened in a new tab.

ctrl_tab.description: Ctrl+Tab order: last used (`mru`) or strip order.

close_pinned.description: Allow Cmd/Ctrl+W to close pinned tabs.

restore.description: Reopen the open tabs when a vault opens.

undo_budget_mb.description: Undo history kept for background tabs, in megabytes.

notes.description: Markdown notes: the reading view and the editor. See [Notes](#notes).

open_in.description: What a note shows when it opens: the reading view or the editor.

vim.description: Vim keys in the note editor.

line_wrap.description: Wrap long lines in the editor.

line_numbers.description: Show line numbers in the editor.

font_size.description: Text size of notes, in pixels.

readable_width.description: Widest the reading text gets, in pixels; 0 uses the whole pane.

autosave_ms.description: Save this long after the last keystroke; 0 saves only with `Notes: Save`.

highlight_code.description: Colour code blocks in the reading view.

math.description: Render `$…$` and `$$…$$` as formulas in the reading view.

remote_images.description: Load images from `http(s)` addresses. Off keeps notes fully offline: the image shows its alt text instead.

toggle_tasks.description: Tick `- [ ]` task checkboxes by clicking them in the reading view. The change is saved through the guarded save; off leaves them read-only.

layout.description: Which parts of the window show, and presets such as focus mode. See [Layout and focus mode](#layout-and-focus-mode).

header.description: Show the vault header (title, save status, History and Graph buttons).

footer.description: Show Excalidraw's footer (zoom, undo and redo, help).

preset.description: A preset to apply at launch and whenever this value changes; `""` = none.

presets.description: Named presets, `[layout.presets.<name>]`, each listing the parts it shows or hides: `header`, `navigator`, `activity_bar`, `tab_strip`, `footer`, `status_bar`. `focus` is built in.

focus.description: What focus mode hides (`View: Focus mode`). See [Layout and focus mode](#layout-and-focus-mode).

hide.description: The parts focus mode hides: `header`, `navigator`, `activity_bar`, `tab_strip`, `footer`, `status_bar`. The canvas and the drawing toolbar always stay.

remember.description: Open in focus mode when it was on at the last quit.

hint.description: Show a small `Focus` chip (with the exit key) while focus mode is on.

sync.description: Vaults inside iCloud Drive, Dropbox, Syncthing or OneDrive. See [Sync services](#sync-services).

conflict_badge.description: Show a `conflict` badge on conflict copies (`name (conflicted copy …)`, `name.sync-conflict-…`, `name 2`) in the file tree.

download_placeholders.description: Ask iCloud to download a drawing that shows as not downloaded when you click it. Off: only its Download button does.

memory.description: Memory kept by open drawings. See [Memory](#memory).

free_unused_images.description: Release image data that no element and no undo or redo step can restore.

undo_steps.description: Undo steps kept per drawing; older steps go, with the images only they could restore.

hidden_purge_s.description: Seconds the window stays hidden before the app frees its caches; 0 never does.

idle_purge_s.description: Seconds without input, while visible, before off-screen caches are freed; 0 never does.

search.description: Search speed trade-offs. Lower counts and a longer wait cost less on a slow machine.

debounce_ms.description: Wait this long after the last keystroke before a search runs.

max_drawings.description: Most drawings listed in the search results.

max_snippets.description: Most matching elements shown under each drawing; the index keeps 5 per drawing, so 5 is the top.

notes.description: Search the Markdown notes (`.md`) of the vault, with their `#tags`, links and headings. Read when the index starts (reopen the vault).

note_text_mb.description: Megabytes of note text the index keeps in memory (16 holds about 6,500 notes). Past it a note keeps its name, headings, tags and links. Read when the index starts; 0 keeps only those.

start.description: When the search index starts: `open` (vault open), `idle` (once the app is idle) or `use` (first search). Tags show once it has started. See [Startup](#startup).

extensions.description: Built-in extensions, on (`true`) or off (`false`). Off means not loaded: no memory, no work, no commands. Changes apply live. See [Extensions](#extensions).

search.description: Search inside drawings from the file tree and the palette; off searches file names only.

links.description: Links between drawings: the links dock, `[[` autocomplete, link styling, hints, back and forward. Renaming still updates links per `links.update_on_rename`.

tags.description: Tags: the tags pane, tag chips, tag search and rename.

library.description: The library sidebar and inserting library items.

templates.description: New drawing from a template, and saving a drawing as one.

formula.description: The formula plugin: insert and edit LaTeX formulas, and render `$…$` in notes (off: notes show the TeX source).

mermaid.description: Mermaid to Excalidraw (the official mermaid plugin: dialog, menu entries, paste conversion and the mermaid.to_drawing method).

pdf-import.description: Import PDF pages into a drawing.

notes.description: Markdown notes: open a `.md` file in a tab with a reading view and an editor. See [Notes](#notes).

history.description: The History panel, timeline, checkpoints and their commands. Versions are still saved while `history.enabled` is on.

keys.description: Key sequences and the which-key popup. `[keys.labels]` names sequence groups (`"<leader> f" = "files"`); its entries are free text and are not checked. See [Key sequences, leader and which-key](#key-sequences-leader-and-which-key).

leader.description: The key `<leader>` stands for in a sequence.

timeout_ms.description: Time allowed between the keys of a sequence; 0 waits for the next key.

cancel_after_ms.description: Drop a half-typed sequence after this long; 0 never does.

which_key.description: Show the which-key popup while a sequence is half typed.

which_key_delay_ms.description: Wait this long before the popup appears.

labels.description: Names of key groups shown in the which-key popup.

history.description: Version history of each drawing, kept in the vault. Older versions thin out: every version, then hourly, daily and weekly ones.

enabled.description: Make versions at all; `false` turns history off.

keep_all_hours.description: Keep every version for this many hours.

keep_hourly_hours.description: Then keep one version per hour for this many hours.

keep_daily_days.description: Then keep one version per day for this many days.

keep_weekly_weeks.description: Then keep one version per week for this many weeks.

size_cap_mb.description: Size cap of a vault's history in megabytes; the oldest versions go first.

highlight_changes.description: Highlight what changed in the History preview.

start.description: When file history starts: `open` (vault open), `idle` or `use` (first edit or history action). Edits made before it starts are not versioned. See [Startup](#startup).

plugins.description: Plugins in the `plugins/` folder of the config folder.

enabled.description: Ids of the plugins to load: your own plugins and official ones that are on. Official plugins (markdown-import, gallery) are on unless listed in `disabled`.

disabled.description: Official plugins you turned off, like `["gallery"]`. Settings writes it; a new official plugin is on until you list it here.

importers.description: Which plugin imports a file extension when two plugins claim it; `""` turns plugin handling off for that extension.

storage_limit_kb.description: Most data one plugin may save with `ctx.storage`, in KiB; a save past it is refused.

scene_max_ops.description: Most ops in one plugin `scene.batch` call; a batch past it is refused.

toolbar.description: Show the strip of buttons plugins declare with `[[contributes.toolbar]]`. It appears only while a plugin declares a button.

status_bar.description: Show the status bar plugins fill with `ctx.statusBar`. It appears only while a plugin item has text.

registry_url.description: The community plugins index that Settings, Plugins, Browse lists (an https address). Needs the plugins consent.

registry_ttl_hours.description: Hours before Browse fetches the plugins index again; 0 fetches every time it opens.

ai.description: AI features, off until you turn them on. See [AI](#ai).

enabled.description: The master switch; turning it on in Settings or with **AI: Toggle AI** first shows a warning.

mcp_enabled.description: The AI tools interface (the `mcp` role of the control socket); it opens only while both keys are `true`.

control.description: Scripts and links from outside. The socket and link keys are read by the native side; see [Control and links](#control-and-links).

notify_edits.description: Show a notice when a script or AI tool edits the drawing on screen.

enabled.description: Start the control socket at launch; `false` turns the `vaultdraw` command's link to the app off.

uri_enabled.description: `false` ignores every `vaultdraw://` link and every drawing or library file opened from outside.

uri_allow.description: What a link may do without asking: "new", "switch-vault", or command ids.

window.description: The window's title bar on Linux. The native side reads it at launch, so a change needs a restart. See [Window title bar (Linux)](#window-title-bar-linux).

decorations.description: Linux only: `custom` hides the system title bar and the app header carries minimize, maximize and close; `native` keeps the system title bar. Needs a restart; ignored on macOS and Windows.

watchdog.description: The hang watchdog: a Wait / Quit dialog when the page stops answering. See [Hang watchdog](#hang-watchdog).

enabled.description: Show a Wait / Quit dialog when the page stops answering (macOS; Linux later).

grace_ms.description: How long the page must stay unresponsive (after WebKit's own 3 s) before the dialog appears, in milliseconds. Applies from the next hang.

network.description: The internet is used only for features you allow, and only when you use them. See [Network](#network).

enabled.description: Master switch: `false` blocks every download, whatever else is allowed. Turning it on from Settings asks in a native dialog.

allow_themes.description: Allow theme downloads. Absent means ask on first use; `true` allows, `false` refuses. Turning it on asks in a native dialog.

allow_plugins.description: Allow the community plugins list and plugin downloads. Absent means ask on first use; `true` allows, `false` refuses. Turning it on asks in a native dialog.

themes.description: Installing themes from the internet. See [Installing more themes](#installing-more-themes).

max_install_kb.description: Largest theme file to accept, in KB (1 to 256).

index_url.description: The community themes index the theme browser lists (an https address). Needs the themes consent.

index_ttl_hours.description: Hours before the browser fetches the index again; 0 fetches every time it opens.

previews.description: Download preview images in the browser; `false` shows colour swatches only.

backup.description: Scheduled vault backups (a manual backup needs none of these). See Backups.

every.description: `off`, `daily` or `weekly`: write a backup when the newest one is older than that. Takes effect the next time a vault opens.

folder.description: Where scheduled backups go; not inside the vault. `~/` starts at your home folder.

keep.description: Backups of this vault to keep in `folder`; older ones this feature made are deleted. At least 1.

include_history.description: Include the file history; it can be large.

hotkeys.description: One entry per command id: a list of keys like ["Mod+S"] or key sequences like ["g g"]; [] removes the default keys.

include.description: Other TOML files or folders to read under this file.

commands.description: [commands.<name>]: a user command, palette id `user.<name>`, running existing commands in order.
